name: Innomet Advanced Materials Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1984, Innomet Advanced Materials Ltd is a manufacturer of specialty powder metallurgy products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
IAML is a global supplier of ferrous and non-ferrous metal /alloy powders and other customized powders. It also manufactures components through high temperature sintering route where it specializes in production of Tungsten Heavy Alloy Components. (Inno Tung)

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Debtor days have increased from 49.0 to 71.4 days.
Working capital days have increased from 152 days to 284 days
